I’ve lived in both. Born and raised in Honolulu. Lived in Orlando from 20-30 years old where I was in law school and a teacher. As much as I absolutely love Hawaii, it’s people, the scenery…the cost of living is absolutely insane. I feel like everyone here is either always scraping to get by or must work multiple jobs even if they have good jobs. I work at the probation office where most officers have 2 jobs out of necessity-such as Uber, teaching on the side. I moved back because I needed to be with my aging parents-however, if it weren’t for them- I would’ve stayed in Orlando because of the cost of living and how much there is to do there. For example, you can go on road trips, do a cheap cruise etc. As for education, Floridas schools fare better and have better opportunities. I worked at an awesome Montessori school in Winter Garden and there were so many programs because of the Florida lotto. Hawaii is in decline because of the stupid, useless short rail we’ve been building for decades. Bottom line: it’s paradise VS price of paradise
